subject: SIG request: clarification on subprocessors and data egress locations
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-payments.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: list of subprocessors + regions (telemetry/support/cloud)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the SIG. Our security team is running a focused review of subprocessors that handle telemetry, support tooling (Zendesk/Intercom), and core cloud providers. For the questionnaire we need: a roster of third parties used by Redwood Inference, plus the primary data egress region(s) for each (e.g., us-west1, eu-west1, etc.).

Specifically:
- Which vendors process telemetry/observability data and where does that data egress to?
- Which support/tooling vendors have access to customer metadata (logs, request IDs, traces)?
- Any cross-border data flows for the above (e.g., backups or analytics in a different region)?

Can you share a single spreadsheet with columns: vendor, purpose, egress_region(s), type_of_data_access, contract_link (if available)?

We have an internal deadline to close the SIG evidence review by Friday COB. If you can share a draft by EOD tomorrow that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

-Maria
Maria Lopez
Security Analyst, Acme Payments

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-payments.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: list of subprocessors + regions (telemetry/support/cloud)

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear ask.

Looping in Rishi (security/compliance) and Neha (platform ops) to pull our canonical roster and confirm egress locations. Rishi — can you pull the latest vendor matrix and flag any vendors with cross-region backups or analytics that might cause cross-border egress? Neha — can you confirm telemetry pipelines (Datadog, S3 paths, bigquery jobs) and where the data leaves the primary region?

I'll aim to send a consolidated spreadsheet (single source) and a short narrative for any vendors with non-obvious flows by EOD tomorrow. If we need to redact contract links for sharing, we can provide internal IDs + where to request the agreement.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops (covering SIG requests)
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, maria.lopez@acme-payments.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: list of subprocessors + regions (telemetry/support/cloud)

Laura / Maria — attaching a working draft: sig_vendor_egress_mapping_v1.xlsx (columns: vendor / purpose / egress_region / data_type / contract_ref). I've populated the cloud providers and primary telemetry vendors we control. Early notes:

- Google Cloud (GCP) — primary region us-central1 for hosted API and tooling; egress for analytics pipelines occurs in us-east4 for our analytics fleet (see attached gcp-egress-diagram.png).
- Datadog — telemetry ingestion is routed from us-central1 to Datadog (US); no EU egress for production telemetry unless customer elects EU tenancy.
- Sentry (error monitoring) — stores traces in us-west2; some aggregated backups run to us-east1 for analytics jobs.
- Zendesk/Intercom (customer support) — metadata and ticket content stored in Zendesk’s US tenant; Intercom attachments may transit to AWS S3 (us-west-2).

Open questions (please confirm):
1) Do we need to separate telemetry versus observability-derived PII/identifiers?
2) For any vendor with multi-region failover (GCP, AWS), do you want us to enumerate failover egress locations or only active egress?

Attachment: sig_vendor_egress_mapping_v1.xlsx (22KB, xlsx)
Attachment: gcp-egress-diagram.png (48KB, png)

-Rishi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-payments.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: list of subprocessors + regions (telemetry/support/cloud)

Thanks Rishi — this is exactly the direction we need. Two clarifications from our side:

- Please include both active egress regions and any automatic failover/backups that could cause data to move across borders. We need to know the superset of locations where customer telemetry or request identifiers might be accessible.
- For support tools (Zendesk/Intercom), we only need to know whether support agents have access to request/trace identifiers or full payloads (logs, stack traces). A short note in the spreadsheet column "data_type" will suffice.

If you can update the workbook and resend by EOD tomorrow we should be able to proceed with evidence review. Appreciate the fast turn.

-Maria

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-payments.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG vendor egress roster — draft and next steps

Maria — attaching the updated roster with failover/backup regions enumerated and short notes on data access for each support/telemetry vendor. Key callouts in the sheet:

- GCP: primary compute in us-central1; analytics jobs run in us-east4; backups replicating to us-east1 (see gcp-egress-diagram.png).
- Datadog: captures request IDs and aggregated traces; no default EU tenancy — flagged as US egress.
- Sentry: stores full stack traces in us-west2; analytics backups to us-east1.
- Zendesk: ticket content is stored in the vendor's US tenant; agents can view ticket content and attached request IDs.

Attachments: sig_vendor_egress_mapping_v1.xlsx, gcp-egress-diagram.png

Next steps:
- Rishi/Neha/Vivek to validate the contract references for the flagged vendors and drop the internal contract ID into the contract_ref column by EOD Thursday.
- Laura to upload final CSV to the shared Drive folder and send signed access path to Acme Security once contracts are validated.

Sharing link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEFghSIGVendorRoster
HubSpot ticket: HS-458237

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough — otherwise I'll push the updated sheet to the folder Thursday evening.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
